newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes nine cents up at 14.89 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes nine cents up at 14.89 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed nine cents higher at 14.89 ringgit ($5.90) a kg after a strong London Metal Exchange (LME) close on Friday, traders said.
"The LME went up sharply and the local market followed through," said a dealer. "But it could not go higher as lots of sellers emerged later."

There were initial bids for 134 tonnes against offers for 94. Final tunover was 124 tonnes, up from 92 on Friday, and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests. The local market was trading at par with the LME, traders said.
